scientific_question: When a capitulum trait differentiation event can be bounded independently in evolutionary time and geography, what environmental state or change accompanied that event, and is any direction repeated across independently bounded events of the same homologous trait transition?

chapter_role.chapter1_conceptual_role: present-day environmental sorting and maintenance is a later cross-chapter synthesis question and is not an input to this analysis
chapter_role.chapter2_primary_role: historical differentiation: recurrence, relative depth, calendar-bounded event windows where possible, and environmental state/change through those windows
chapter_role.chapter3_boundary: selection, mechanism and reproductive fitness are not inferred here

required_for_environmental_event_analysi: trait state or phenotype contrast independently identified
a branch or lineage interval bounded by public chronology without converting relative lineage depth to calendar time
a predeclared paleolocation scenario or explicit geographic uncertainty envelope
a historical environmental series covering the full event interval
event_admission.conditional_transition_allowed: A conditional ancestral-to-derived direction may be retained only with its condition explicit; it cannot be counted as a resolved repeated transition.
event_admission.sister_contrast_only: A dated sister phenotype contrast is retained in the event ledger but is not a reconstructed trait transition.
event_admission.range_event_only: A dated dispersal/range event is retained but cannot be assigned as the age of a trait transition unless the trait-changing branch is independently reconciled.

primary_orientation_source.event: erect_or_upward -> nodding_or_downward on the core-Nipponocirsium stem
primary_orientation_source.chronology: 94 deterministic admissible parent-child age pairs spanning the separately published node-age marginals; not posterior samples
primary_orientation_source.important_reanalysis_rule: Use only raw branch-endpoint delta and same-duration matched-window background_z from scenario_rows. Ignore every Azami-vector direction_agreement and cosine field in the source artifact.

event_environment_estimands.delta: regional median at the younger branch endpoint minus regional median at the older branch endpoint
event_environment_estimands.background_z: event delta standardized against all same-duration windows stepped every 10 kyr in the same paleolocation region and variable
event_environment_estimands.cross_region_direction_rule: robust_increase only when q05(delta) > 0 in every predeclared paleolocation region; robust_decrease only when q95(delta) < 0 in every region; otherwise direction_unresolved
event_environment_estimands.cross_region_background_rule: consistently_above_matched_windows only when q05(background_z) > 0 in every region; consistently_below_matched_windows only when q95(background_z) < 0 in every region; otherwise matched_window_position_unresolved
event_environment_estimands.interpretation: q05/q95 summarize the deterministic chronology scenario grid and are not probability or credible intervals.

repeated_trigger_rule.same_trait_requirement: events must represent the same homologous trait axis and compatible ancestral-to-derived direction

classification.repeated_direction_candidate: at least two independently bounded events have the same robust environmental direction for the same historical variable
classification.direction_not_repeated: at least two independently bounded events are evaluable but robust directions conflict
classification.not_evaluable: fewer than two independently bounded homologous transition events have historical environment results

repeated_trigger_rule.causal_ceiling: A repeated direction is a historical differentiation-trigger candidate, not evidence that the environmental variable was a selective agent.

current_expected_identifiability.orientation: one calendar-and-paleolocation-bounded transition envelope; environmental direction can be evaluated but repeated-trigger recurrence is not evaluable from one event
current_expected_identifiability.flower_colour: two conditional terminal branch envelopes exist, but exact transition timing/direction and a directly relevant historical radiative series remain insufficient for a resolved repeated trigger test
current_expected_identifiability.phyllary_posture: dated sister phenotype contrasts exist but are not reconstructed posture transitions
current_expected_identifiability.stickiness: relative repeated history is resolved but published range-event ages are not the trait-transition ages

claim_boundary: Do not use Chapter 1 or Azami effect signs to classify historical environmental change.
Do not interpret chronology-grid q05/q95 as posterior credible intervals.
Do not assign an event to one paleolocation scenario when several remain admissible.
Do not convert lineage split ages, range events or relative lineage depth into exact trait-transition dates.
A robust event-associated environmental direction is a historical alignment or trigger candidate only, not natural selection or adaptation.
A single evaluable event cannot establish repeated environmental triggering.
